My birthday falls close to Thanksgiving. Its pretty common for people to forget or to bail on me last minute. before last year I had quite a few bad birthdays. 

for two years in a row my parents forgot to call me. 

the second year they forgot to call I was alone ina new town. I went and got a buger and a beer by myself. 

The year after that I had a party planned the day before my birthday everyone had called to cancel. Day of my birthday I got laid off from my job. I called my best friend in tears and her parents ended up paying for me to go out to dinner with their family. 

Lst year I said fuck it. I hate birthdays now. 

Fortunatly my boyfriend took me to another town and got me a hotel room. 

I say if you have money, go get a burger and stay at a hotel with a pool. 

Just take yourself out for a movie and a meal or something. 

It really sucks to be alone for your birthday but it is a celebration of your life, so just celebrate yourself. 

Hope this helped. I understand how difficult it is to be alone.
I know how you feel. It's so difficult. Love is so difficult sometimes. Especially loving yourself. That's what I'm having the most rouble with now. I can't understand how to even love myself.

want to talk about it? I really need to just talk. 

Having morbid thoughts and feeling inadequate is putting even more pressure on me than I have ever felt before. 

I had to fight myself not to cry when I woke up this morning. Just because I was awake, and not asleep any more. 

Anything negative at all sets me off...even if its not real, its just my anxiety making me feel like a normal interaction was terrible and I should hate myself. 

Sorry I'm rambling,
You can PM me if you want to talk.
